purpose: Trace a single projection witness and identify which carriers are preserved or transformed under projection from the Core Expression into a domain-specific RT.

trace.reading: A provisional generative label is used for projection typing only and remains distinct from RT_core.
The receiving domain is declared before projection is formed.
The projection is typed by domain, scale, and admissibility.
The projection yields a candidate RT witness rather than an identity claim.
Closure eligibility is checked after projection and before any completion claim.
Identity continuity is preserved in this witness because the completed RT remains the same governed identity after closure verification.
Residue, orientation, state, scale-expression, metric value, and slot role may vary by receiving domain.

forbidden_inferences: Projection does not imply residue preservation across all domains.
Projection does not imply orientation preservation across all domains.
Projection does not imply slot-role symmetry.
Projection does not identify the Core Expression with RT_core.
